name: Blessing of Muin [Ogham]
body:
The vine of life strongly binds you to your allies and loved ones, blessing you through the muin ogham.

Prerequisite(s): Ogham Connection or the Ogham-Craobh class feature.

Benefit(s): You are able to spur yourself and your allies that can hear you to fight through the greatest of ordeals. You and allies within 30 ft. gain a +1 morale bonus to any Will saves versus compulsion or fear-based effects as long as you can speak and the allies within range can hear you.

For every ogham feat you possess beyond this one, the morale bonus increases by +1 (maximum of +5).
